lead_raw_text:
The Sr6Cd2Mo2O16 structure (reduced formula Sr3CdMoO8) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4_1/a (No. 143), with 26 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Cd and Mo centers each coordinated by six O neighbors, while Sr centers have eight O neighbors. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 26 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows O-centered octahedra sharing corners and edges, and corner-sharing between O octahedra and Sr polyhedra.
